correctness.rationale: Coverage is the complete union of the n-bit Hamming balls of radius two about the cyclic windows, including wraparound at L<n. Both frozen C++ listings test this predicate and traverse the stated finite domains; they were inspected, not executed. Independently, from /workspace/branches run python3 audit4.py /workspace/source/2026/11/02/rotation-classes-of-shortest-binary-radius-two-covering-cycles-a--990feb7a83ea (NumPy; replay output audit4.out). The independent search compares every L-bit integer with every cyclic rotation before testing one representative per orbit. It constructs repeated-word windows, checks coverage by removing targets differing at zero, one or two positions, and sums the first-return rotation periods to recover the indexed counts. It matches all 44 length rows and every field of all 14 orbit rows, with zeros for every shorter length. The minima, indexed counts and orbit totals are (10,110,11), (14,28,2), (20,20,1). Full periods also follow from minimality: otherwise the shorter period supplies the same circular windows. The sole order-nine representative is the given 20-bit string; its complement and reverse were tested directly among its rotations. This is exhaustive only for the specified orders, radius and bounded lengths.

evidence: Chung–Cooper note every shortest length-M cycle has M distinct rotations. Ta–Vu give constructive asymptotic upper bounds for fixed alphabet and radius as n grows.
The nearby complete binary census cd1d48014b9f treats radius one, order seven, and reports length 22, 132 indexed cycles and six rotation classes.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Full orbit size and asymptotic upper bounds are broader results about different statistics. A census of radius-one optima does not enumerate radius-two optima; the predicates and minimal lengths differ.

value.rationale: For optimal cyclic covering sequences, counting all designs up to rotation is a natural classification beyond minimum length and construction. These are three consecutive benchmark orders from the foundational table, not arbitrary isolated examples. The exact census tells a researcher when another shortest design can be sought, establishes optimal-design rigidity at order nine, and supplies all canonical inputs at the two nearby orders. Its finite scope does not diminish those uses.
